name: Cladribine (2-CdA) (Hairy Cell Leukemia)

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Hairy Cell Leukemia v1.2026

supportiveCare: PJP prophylaxis with Bactrim DS 3x/week for at least 6 months post-therapy
Acyclovir 400 mg PO BID for VZV prophylaxis
Irradiated blood products mandatory to prevent transfusion-associated GVHD

drugs.name: Cladribine
drugs.notes: Cladribine 0.14 mg/kg/day IV over 2 hours on Days 1-5 (single 5-day course yields >90% overall response and ~80% complete response).
